create_concrete_args: create fake example inputs with symbolic dims replaced by a concrete size for single-size compilation
get_fake_args_from_graph: get fake args directly from a torch FX graph's placeholder nodes
build_piecewise_backend: build a piecewise compilation backend that dispatches compiled graphs based on runtime input shape

load_all_ranges: load all pre-compiled runnables from cached artifacts for warm start without re-compiling
